title: 2022 HMMT November Guts Problem 11
statement: Isosceles trapezoid \(A B C D\) with bases \(A B\) and \(C D\) has a point \(P\) on \(A B\) with \(A P=11, B P=27\), \(C D=34\), and \(\angle C P D=90^{\circ}\). Compute the height of isosceles trapezoid \(A B C D\).

solutions.text: Drop projections of \(A, P, B\) onto \(C D\) to get \(A^{\prime}, P^{\prime}, B^{\prime}\). Since \(A^{\prime} B^{\prime}=38\) and \(C D=34\), we get that \(D A^{\prime}=C B^{\prime}=2\). Thus, \(P^{\prime} D=9\) and \(P^{\prime} C=25\). Hence, the answer is \(P P^{\prime}=\sqrt{P^{\prime} D \cdot P^{\prime} C}=\) 15.
